description: NaAlH₂₄(SO₁₀)₂ crystallizes in the cubic Pa̅3 space group. Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.51 Å. Al is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Al-O bond lengths are 1.91 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.02 Å) and one longer (1.60 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.70 Å) H-O bond length. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.74 Å) H-O bond length. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are three shorter (1.49 Å) and one longer (1.50 Å) S-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two H and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and three H atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Al and two H atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one S atom.
